integrity: The result has a self-contained finite incidence proof with a standalone exhaustive two-method checker; the author makes no claim of external certification or priority over the published minimum cardinality.
scientific_limitations: This is an exact finite classification for ordinary locating-dominating sets in the Heawood incidence graph, not for identifying codes or other graphs. The minimum size of six was established by Balbuena, Foucaud and Hansberg; the contribution is multiplicity 448 and four automorphism types. Equivalent earlier classifications under Fano-plane test-cover terminology remain a bibliographic risk; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Four symmetry types and 448 minimum locating-dominating codes of the Heawood graph
